caption: The new entrance to the enlarged cemetery on the L4202, with its lovely stone pillars, dedication plaque and gravel sweep (May 2026)
Looking through the new cemetery gates to the burial ground beyond (May 2026)

Construction of the graveyard extension well underway in early 2025. You can see the info board on the left with the layout drawing and the digger getting stuck into the new ground. A big project for the village and great to see it coming together (Spring 2025)
